content:
The execution failed due to schema mismatches in the JSON output and incorrect application of patient counts in the reimbursement logic.
The 'assumptions' field contained a list of strings instead of a dictionary of constants, and 'total_annual_margin_30_day_usd' was missing from the totals object. An AssertionError occurred because the script output text instead of structured data. The calculation logic incorrectly factored in patient counts twice, ignoring that 'reimbursement_per_fill_240_patients_usd' already included the 240-patient multiplier.
